Eyesibini YAZALA iintombi ezimbini, uNontini noNontlangu, YAZA
eyesithathu,  uNowinile  lo, yazala umntwana wamnye ogama linguJongikhaya.

Apha kwakhayakhulu njengokuba kungabonakali bantu baninzi nje, kungenxa
yokuba abantwana basekhaya apha bonke BEMKA baya kuzimela.

UFumbalele WABA nowakhe umzi WAZA uMguqulwa watshipha.

UNontini noNontlangu BENDA WAZA uJongikhaya WAYA kuzimela kumhlaba
waseBhityi apho wadibana nomThembukazi wamlobela kwelo lakowabo.

Eli  Juda  LAXHUZULA  imali   engangeeponti  ezintathu ngenyanga nganye
emvuzweni wakhe, LATHI liya kuze liyikhuphe mhla yena weza nomntwana wakhe aza kumfundisa.

LATHI limlobola labe limshiya nomzi lisiya kusebenza.

BAYEKA bengaphumanga kwibanga lesiThandathu BAZA baya kufuna umsebenzi
 eMonti .

BARHUMRHEKA kukuya kudla  iiholide   eMonti  kudade bonina BAGQIBELA
ngokubaleka  isikolo .

WATHI esenza ibanga lesiNe WEMKA namanye amakhwenkwe.

BAJOYINA kwaTebha BASINGA  eRhawutini .

BAFIKA BASEBENZA kumgodi okufutshane  eStirtonville   eseBoksburg , ogama
 liyi-=East=  =Rand= =Prop.=. =Mines=.

Wasondela uNtombi wamtshicela ebusweni uZuziwe.  

Zahleka zacubhuka iintshaba zakhe, zimkhwaza, zimgxwala.  

Kwaphendula uMamiya, inkosikazi  kaMvangeli , wathi:  Ayinakuba
nguMlenzan' olibazis' uZuziwe.  

Waphendula ngelizwi elipholileyo wathi:  Hayi,  bhut'  Duma,
ungaphazami.  

Akuliva igama likaBhuqa, amehlo kaDuma atshawuza okombane, wanqumama
kancinci uZuziwe akuyiphawula loo nto.  

Guqu-guqu-guqu, wakhanyisa, yavutha into yakhona. 

Mna loo pulayima ndathi mhla ndayibona  uNosawuti  eyidumisa kulo mzi
kabawo ndayikhupha ngomnyango ibhabha. 

Wabalekisa umlomo uZuziwe, wamtyhala kancinci, wathi:  "Kutheni
utshawuz' okombane nje?"  

WATHI mhla wehla WEHLELA ukuya kwaluka ekuqaleni kuka-=1=9=42=.

BAZALELWA bakhuliselwa kwiimeko ezilolu hlobo.

LATHI kuba ichibi belinzulu wakhutshwa sesithe pitsi ukuzala isisu.

ATHI akuphawula izithonga zakhe, azama into yokuba amxhinkxe azokudideka.

Ngamhlazana uthile kuthe esaphumle egumbini lakhe wafumana incwadi
evela kuKhanyisile ebetha koozelekazi, emxholo uthi, "Thantaswa, NDAZIFUMANA zonke ezakho, ANDAZIPHENDULA ngabom."

Wasondela kancinci uBhuqa, wambamba ngesandla uZuziwe, wamtsalela
kuye efuna ukumphuza.  

Wasinda ekurhaxweni kuba umlambo ungenzulu kule ndawo, waba nako
ukuma ngenyawo kwavela intloko.  

Bamshiya baya kuqhuba umdlalo wabo, bezonwabisa ngokuqubha nokudada
nokudlala emanzini, bayeka ukuzikhathaza ngeenkathazo ezingapheliyo zelizwe.

Akuba egqibile amadoda anikela kwikhankatha lawo liwase kwindlu yawo esele ilungisiwe, LAWATHABATHA laya kuwangenisa.

"Ndiqinisekile bayakukhumbula, kudala wabagqibela."  

Wakhiwa ke wojiwa kamnandi.  

Ngenxa yokuba azilahleki zinenombolo wavakalelwa lowo kwakugudlwe
yena, naye akalinda wabuza ukuba eli gama lale nja lithetha ukuthini na, xa ngathi libhekisa kubo nje. 

Ngenye imini yathi intwana endwebileyo yakumbona entywila, nayo
yantywila kwakuloo ndawo, yambamba phantsi kwamanzi, yamphuza, yamphathaphatha emabeleni.  

Mhla ndabuya wandithengela  itikiti  wandithengela umphako, akandinika
nemdaka yokuba ze ndikwazi nokuthenga into endiyithandayo. 

Wothuka wakhala uZuziwe, waphants' ukuwela emlanjeni, esothuswa kukuva
umntu sel' esitsho ezindlebeni zakhe engakhange amve ukuza kwakhe.  

Wabulisa, wa hamba phofu eshiya umyalezo othi, "nize nincede
ningawaniki bantwana la magama anje, athethayo, hleze abantu bawalandele". 

Emva kwesidlo sakusasa konwatywa kwada kwafika ixesha lokuba kukhiwe
umbona omtsha esitiyeni. 

Ngenxa yokuhlonipha umtshayelo ixhegwazana nalo ladinwa kukuxambula
lathiya inja lathi nguXhents'enkunkumeni. 
KE
Le njana kuthethwa ngayo ke yayingeyodwa;zazine. 

Khawumbuze ukuba  abhetele  ngantoni na WONA loo maqaba waya kuzifaka kuwo
selelolu thwekesha lungazaziyo nje ngoku nalapho lukhona.

Ziphi zona ezo gusha nezo nkomo siphila  komaRhawuti  nje? 

Aqaqambile engqondweni yakhe amazwi kaKhanyisile athi, "THINA
sobabini, Ntombentle, asinakwahlulwa naziindudumo."

THINA sobabini asinakwahlulwa naziindudumo.

WENA ke mntu  wasesikolweni  wobala ufumanise ukuba ekubhalweni kweli
bali ukhehle lo wayekwisithuba samashumi asibhozo anesibini ubudala.

WENA ke mntu  wasesikolweni  uya kumthekelela kwiminyaka engama-=57=, kuba
umkhuluwa wakhe ukwisithuba sama-=61= eminyaka.

Uhambile ke YENA umntwana wakwaDiliza wada wayokufika kowabo,
walichitha kamnandi ikhefu lakhe  nePasika  phofu engazi ukuba kukwakho
nezigcayiselo elonwabeni lwakhe.

Ihleli ethembeni YONA intombi kaDiliza, icinga ukuba makube kukho
iingxaki ezithile abanjezelwe zizo uKhanyisile.

Phofu YONA ingqondo yakhe ibilubengu ubukhali obu.

Ikhona YONA imini awaphantsa waya kuziqengqa eliweni ngenxa yesifo
samagxa esamhlasela ngokusuka abone uThantaswa noKhanyisile behleli phantsi komngcunube, bepholelwe ngamalanga kwincochoyi yeentaba zonandiphiso.

Nako ke YENA uThantaswa esiya kuyibonisa  ititshala  inje ngokuba
injalo, akugqiba ukuyifunda.

Yena ke umfazi wayengayiva. 

Zihambile zona IINTSUKU njengesiqhelo phofu kungekho nto icacayo
kuThantaswa ngaphandle kokunxunguphala.

Ngelo xesha yena UTHANTASWA wayesaqeqeshelwa ubongikazi kwisibhedlele
salapha ekuthiwa  yiNightingale .

Ahleli wona amatye azinzile, atsho kube lula ukuwela naxa umlambo
unamanzi.  

Zaqengeleka zona iintsuku engafiki. 

Waba ngabongoza wasuka YENA uThantaswa wathi tu, akathetha nelimdaka.

Ibisel' idlulile kodwa YONA  iPasika .

Ebesel' efudukele  eMabopane  umfana wakwaMvelase, emphose kwichibi
lokulibala uThantaswa phofu LONA izulu aladibana nomhlaba.

Uhlambile yena uNongxaki.  

"Akwaba ebenokusikeleleka loo mazwi uwathethayo, =K.K=., ukuze ingqayi
yolu thando lwethu ingakroboki, ime imi OKWENTABA eluqilima, YONA
ingahexahexiyo, ingadilikiyo nokuba sekugqutha, kusina, kisithini na", utshilo encumile uThantaswa.

"Akwaba ebenokusikeleleka loo mazwi uwathethayo, =K.K=., ukuze ingqayi
yolu thando lwethu ingakroboki, ime imi okwentaba eluqilima, YONA
ingahexahexiyo, ingadilikiyo nokuba sekugqutha, kusina, kisithini na", utshilo encumile uThantaswa.

"Qonda kakuhle, Ntombentle, ukuba intetho yesiLungu ethi, =out= =of=
=sight=, =out= =of= =mind=, andihambisani nayo MNA kuba kaloku ndikholose ngaleyo ithi, =absence= =makes= =the= =heart= =grow= =fonder=."

Ukufika kwayo (inqwelo-moya)  eKimberley  kubangele ukukhubeka
nokukhathazeka kweentliziyo kwesi sibini njengoko bekusalatha ukwahlukana kwaso, uKhanyisile eza kubuyela  eRhawutini  YENA.

Uhlalutya nezinto aqhel' ukuxelelwa ZONA ngumfana wakwaMvelase.

"Makhe ndilinge LONA."

"Ungandixeleli loo mfeketho MNA."

Kodwa YENA ngenxa yokuba umkakhe uManMtlani, intombi yakwaNkonki
eQholotha, ingazange ivisisane ncam noninazala bagqiba ekubeni bazifunele inxiwa, bazakhele.

Kuthiwa inxeba lendoda alihlekwa kodwa YENA akanakungalihleki
elibona.

Naxa YENA ebengazibizi ngokuba ulixhwele kodwa ubungenakufa uVimba
ekho.

"Kambe ke nditsho kuba WENA, Ntombentle, ulithende elimpompoza
ulonwabo nothando ebomini bam," uvakele esitsho  eKenilworth  Khanyisile Mvelase, umfana wakwaZulu, ethetha nalowo uthe ngco kuye entliziyweni, uThantswa Diliza, intombe yakwa Ndlambe.

ZONA zizakhela iingxukuma zeengxande ezisixwexwe ezifana nezo
zifunyanwa  ezidolophini .

Umfo kaMfanti wabetha ngenqindi phantsi wathi YENA akasoze aye
emfazweni.

"MNA, =Sister=, ndibona ukuba makhe nditsalel' umnxeba kwiSebe
leMfundo, ndibuze  isikolo  afakwe kuso ndawonye  nedilesi  yaso,"  itshilo intombi kaDiliza ngaminazana ithile iphethwe ngumvandedwa.

Wena, Diliza, ubathiyelen' abant' abangazange bakone?  

Mna ndibona ngathi uzenze ngokuyiphekuza, ndibona ngathi inqandeka lula
xa umntu emi engaphakamisi sandla, uhambise watsho uZithulele sel ebona ukuba undwendwe lwakhe lukhathazekile. 

Iminyaka ihambile iintanga zikaNongxaki zibaleka  esikolweni , yena
uyaququzela ekhaya. 

Wayesithi xa ethetha athi YENA akazange afelwe yimpahla.

Umntwana wesithathu oza emva koNozizwe nowayebizwa ngokuba nguDini YENA
waba nakho ukugqitha  kwaJ.C .

UBakholise lo akayongulube;  yinyhwagi;  WENA ke ungumhlangala.

Ndingabutha nalaa mgulukudu mna?
 Juda  laxhuzula  imali   engangeeponti  ezintathu ngenyanga nganye
emvuzweni wakhe, lathi liya kuze liyikhuphe mhla YENA weza nomntwana wakhe aza kumfundisa.

"Uwubuza loo mbuzo kuba kuthanda mna?"  

Kodwa ke YENA waba neshishinana awayeliqhuba.

Naxa wayengekho YENA  eSharpville  ngaloo mini yomlo kodwa kwaba ngathi
wayekho.

Musa ukwenyelisa;  vuma inyaniso WENA.

Ebengazi YENA  torho  ukuba isizekabani sayo yonke le nqontsonqa
ngumfanekiso wakhe ndawonye nenkcazo enxulumene nawo ephume kwiNdyebo yeSizwe.

"Ndiqinisekile ukuba WENA awazi nto ngaye."

"Andilibali MNA eyokuphumza ingqondo kowabo kanti intliziyo yakhe
isemalandalahla."

"Ndiyakuva Thantaswa, kodwa ke MNA ndinoluvo lokuba undlela-lula
kukuwutsalela  kwiofisi   yabahloli-zikolo  bengingqi yaseMabopane."

YENA ucinge ukuba le yintatheli entsha yeli phephandaba, alwamfikela
uluvo lokuba ikwanguThenjiwe lo.

Kaloku YENA ude watshata noKhanyisile kwakwezo ntsuku kwaye ke igama
lakhe lasekwendeni nguNozuko.

BONA bakhule bebabona oonina nooyise bephila kukuthengisa utywala
besiNtu nesiLungu, kukuqhekeza kwabo bangasebenziyo.

UNomanti noKhuziwe BONA abazange bende.

Kungenjalo yintoni ke ebangela ukuba athi akuba etshatile YENA acinge
ukuba noThantaswa utshatile?

Wayengumntwana omhle kakhulu, ovunyiweyo ngobuhle bakhe kwilali
yakowabo kwaZidenge, emaHlubini, eyayithe zinze phantsi kweNduli yakwaZidenge.

Ndiza kuza apho kuba ndiya kubuya nini, zendiwugqibe nini lo msebenzi
mninzi kangaka?

Zandithuka ngezithukw' ezibi kakhulu, ngokukodw' uNtombi othe
andinyanisekanga ndilihule, ndidlala ngomza wakhe.  

UMaKhumalo lo watsho ngesigelekede senkwenkwe ENTLE kunene.

Wabuza  uMvangeli  ngomsindo:  Ubusenza ntoni emlanjeni ixesh' elide
kangaka, Zuziwe?  

"Ndingala amasoka AMANINZI kangaka ndithambele kuye kanti ndizikhanda
ngelitye emnweni!"

"Yintoni le ifun' ixesh' elide kangako?"  

Loo mhla yaba NGOMKHULU umthwalo  kutitshala .

ELINYE laloo magumbi ke ebelinike uThantaswa lo ukuba ahlale kulo.

AMABINI okuqala selalishiya eli phakade.

Ngokuhamba kweminyaka, ziye  iilokishi  ezindala ezingamabobosi
zachithwa kwaza endaweni yazo kwakhiwa EZINTSHA.

Andinamntwana uza kujikwa ingqondo afakwe entsha. 

Kodwa ndakufane ndikuyeke ngenxa yentang' am,  uKatana  kodwa ndiv' embi
ukub' intang' am izalane nesifeb' esinye.  

Ifikile inkumbulo ethi KANENE esi situlo ahleli kuso sasithengwa ngulo
nyana wakhe, lo namhlanje ubhalwa ezincwadini ezimnyama ngunina.

INENE sithi kuni zimbalwa izifundiswa ezikwaziyo ukuthetha zingakhange
zisebenzise amagama ezinye iilwimi entetheweni yazo.

OKUNENE uThantaswa ubethe  imfonomfono , wabuzisa kumabhalana
wabahloli.

KANENE ucinga ukuba siyaqhula.

Ngaphandle nje kwaleyo yokukhaba nokungqula, ibibakho naleyo imidlalo
yamanqindi apho ULUTSHA beluqeqeshelwa ukudibana neenjinga zehlabathi.

"Ungenzani NGOBULUNGISA?"

Intliziyo yakhe ISEBUGXWAYIBENI, igutyungelwe ngamafu angqingqwa,
awalath' iindudumo nezikhukula.

Nokwenza andiphoxe kangaka ekubeni ENGUMKHAYA?

UKhanyisile yena ebesithi nguNtombentle xa embiza ngenxa yobo BUHLE
bakhe.

Naxa UNINZI lwawo lwabhanga, kodwa asekho namanye asabanga
unxunguphalo.

UBakhulule lo ebemfuna ngandlela zonke uThantaswa ukususela
kwakwiintsuku ZOBUTSHA babo.

Kodwa umntwana  waseRhawutini  wayeyazi into yokuba kuza kuthi
kusonwatywe njalo kuvuke ingxabano phakathi kwababukeli ngokusuka kuphikisane ULUTSHA ngelona qela liza kugqwesa amanye.

Ikhaya lakhe liseTsholomnqa kwakwelakwaNdlambe;  ukutsho oko ke
NGUMKHAYA kuThantaswa.

Unkabi uyaya kweso  sikolo  sithetha ulwimi lwakhe, afunde mhlawumbi ade
aye kufika  kwiMatriki  okanye kwincwadi  YOBUTITSHALA .

Kodwa UNINZI luphelela esithubeni lungene  ezifektri ,  esitalatweni 
okanye ezindaweni ezizisa  imali .

Sowukhe wayibona iNdyebo yeSizwe YAKUTSHANJE?

Ngaloo mihla UBUKHULU beendawo zokuhlala abantu yayingamabobosi akhiwe
 ngamazinki  aza ngaphakathi ahlulwa  ngamakhadibhodi , iinto ezithi kwakuna kutsho kuvuze yonke indlu.

Ebeyithanda le nzwakazi kangangokuba ebekhe ancwase ukulibumba kunye
nayo IKAMVA lakhe ukuba izinto zimhambela ngendlela etyenenezekileyo ebomini.

Kanye NGOKOBUNINZI beziphaluka zeli  leTranskei  iphela, uCentane yindawo
onokuthi ufunde ubume  beTranskei  ngokuqwalasela imo nemeko yalapha.

Njengoko adla ngokuthi umntu akufumana ubunzima ebomini anqwenele
ukuba abantwana bakhe bona bangabufumani UBUNZIMA awayebufumene, ngelinye ixesha kuye kwenzeke ukuba nabantwana imbandezelo ibambathe.

Umninawa kaFumbalele ogama linguMguqulwa yena wayenomkhwa wokutshipha
kuba wemka apha  ngo-1=9=38  eseligatyana ELIBUDALA bulishumi elinesithandathu.

Ngezo mini uThantaswa lo wayesathiwe lwale ziingqondo ZOBUNTWANA.

UMguqulwa ngovelwano nengqondo YOBUFANA wayithatha ukutshayisa kwakhe
wayifunela indawo yokuhlala kwathi kanti kukuqala KOBUHLOBO babo obo.

Ngamanye amaxesha wayenyanzeleka ukuba avuke ngentsimbi YESITHATHU
esukela ukuqala ngentsimbi yesine ekuseni.

Kwakha kwathi ngenye imini uMguqulwa ephangele eshiye UBUMPAHLANA
bakhe kwelinye igumbi awayeliqeshile, wathi ebuya wafika kungasekho ndlu.

Nababekhathazwa zizintso, amazantsi esisu, imiqolo, izinge,
ukurhawuzelelwa, ukungafumani bantwana, ukuphunzelwa ziinkomo njalo njalo babesiza apha kuye kuba ebenolwazi ngamayeza ESINTU.

Le mpi yempucuko nemfundo isabethwa NGOBUNINZI yile mpi kaPhalo
yomthonyama.

Kaloku umfo lo wayesebenza ngeemini ZOBUTSHA bakhe kumzi  weJuda   eKapa .

Uyise wamsa  eJabulani  =Training= =School=  eKilnerton  apho wayeye kufunda
ibanga  LOBUTITSHALA .

Konke ke apho ngaselunxwemeni ukususela emlonyeni weNciba kuye kujikela
 ngaseSajonisi  kwelamaMpondo, zezo ngxondorha zoyikekayo ezide zaba ngumtsalane omkhulu kubakhenkethi abafuna ukubona UBUHLE  beTranskei  iphela.

Kodwa ke wayekholwa kwangamakhwenkwe ngaphezu kweentombi.  

"AKWABA ebenokusikeleleka loo mazwi uwathethayo, =K.K=., ukuze ingqayi
yolu thando lwethu ingakroboki, ime imi okwentaba eluqilima, yona
ingahexahexiyo, ingadilikiyo nokuba sekugqutha, kusina, kisithini na", utshilo encumile uThantaswa.

AKWABA bendingumzobi, bendiya kwenza umfanekiso  otolika  imbilini yam
ngawe.

kwala kanye ukuba abe sesinqeni seqhina elo, weva ukuba ikho le  moto 
ingasemva kwakhe.

KWALILE  xa kanye eseshumini leminyaka ubudala waphuthunywa nguyise
uKhakhakha lo, selenalo igama eli, kuba lathiywa nguyise omkhulu wakulonina, ngeenjongo zokuba igama eli limfuze, kuba waphepha into enzima - ukufa.

Myek' abalis' agqibe, wandul' ukubuza akugqib' ukubalisa.  

Ukuhlwayela impama mfana wam kukuhlwayela ngokusazsa nje kwintsimi
engalinywanga uze WANDULE ukulima ugqumelele.

Khawuye kufunda isimilo WANDULE ukuza kungena kule yam indlu.

Uhleli apho lajika ilanga, WANDULA wagoduka. 

Waphawula ukuba ishicilelwe  eMonti  nakubeni isandla ENGANDULANGA
wasiqaphela.

Madoda!  Khawuye kulaa ndlu, wobuye ubizwe, WANDULE uxelelwe into obizelwa yona.

Bendicela ukuba umzi UNGANDULE uyithathe shushu le nto.

Ewe,ndiyayazi loo nto kudala wayithetha,kodwa ke namhlanje kukho into
ebalukekileyo endikufuna ngayo endingenakuyithetha apha emnxebeni.

Wawungamva esithi xa athetha neetshomi zakhe, "Le  Goli  andisoze
ndiyishiye kuba APHA kukwanyama ayipheli, kuphela amazinyo endoda."

Wayebisa NALAPHA ekuthengiseni utywala.

Ngeli xesha wayesafuna umsebenzi wayesangxungxe APHA kuloMkhize kuba
uyise wayethengisa iinkuni namalahle, ewasa emizini yabantu  ngeelori  zakhe.

Akroza ke la madoda ekhaphana ngenxa yokoyika isaqhwithi sokufika
kukaNgqosini, Utshaba lwakhe lona lwaluselusukile kulaa ndawo lwaluhleli kuyo,
phofu kungekho waziyo nokuba luzikhethele siphi na isikhundla ngoko, kuba
lwalunayo nendawo yokuthi lumkhaphe umntu xa lungathanga lumbone ukufika kwakhe.

Uyithetha kuba unenkwenkwe yomThembu oncuma nayo? 

Ebekhe azikhumbule iimini zobuntwana, esisidalwa nje sikaThixo, engazi
nokuba kuphi, atsiba-tsibe emanzini, adade, antywile, kuba wayelichule kwelo
cala.

koko ebebhajiswa ngumsindo.

endifuna khesiyixoxe sobabini.

embindini womhlaba, atsitse, enze ichibikazi elikhulu kwincochoyi yeBhukazana,

efun' ixesh' elaneleyo".

 ngeKrismesi , nangosuku lokungena konyaka omtsha, nangeemini zemitshato.

ngenye IMINI.

ningawaniki bantwana la magama anje, athethayo, hleze abantu bawalandele".

Phofu noko ayisisusanga isihlunu, kufuneka nje kunqandwe ubuzaza. 

Kwabakho umntu ombonayo loo mntwana, PHOFU selevukile, ntonje esadengile.

nawe ngawo onke amaxesha afanelekileyo.

YAYIGALELEKILE inkosana awayekade eyilindile, eqonda ukuba kumhla wayindoda
naxa wayesel ebala izilimela.

Wajwaqeka uZithulele ethetha eziphendula kodwa wakhetha ukuthula;
wathula iminyaka. 

YAQENGQELEKA iminyaka kuhleliwe kumnandi, nabantwana bekhula.

Lo msebenzi ungaka uthathe le minyaka ingaka, WENZEKA lo mfo kaMfanti
ephaya.

"Bafondini, ndiyabona unyoko uye waxakeka namhlanje", uthsilo
uZithulele, wagqiba wazithulela.  

"Yinto nje engenamsebenzi eyenzeka kudala ndisemncinci endingafuni
kukuxelela yona." 

"Ndingaphants' ukuqinisek' ukuba ziya kuba kho eziny' iintombi,
singalifuman' ithuba lokuthetha." 

Wayeqhelile ukuzitshololo ezintombini, eqinisekile ukuba akanakoyiswa
yintwazana engakanana, efikayo kwezi zinto. 

Ndiyeke ndicumze la mabel' ayo, ndigqabhuze esi sisu sayo kuba
kusenokwenzek' ukuba imithisiwe yilaa nkwenkwe. 

"Ungacing' ukuba ndingaba bantu banyabileyo, batyhafileyo,
ongenakuqiniseka ukuba ngamadoda enene.  

"Ndiqinisekile banexhal' ekhaya, ixhala lamakhwenkw' asigezelayo xa
size kukh' amanzi."  

Wahamba esithi ngelakhe uyamshiya, ecinga ukuba uya kujika agoduke,
ahambe yena aye emlanjeni yedwa, eqinisekile ukuba umoya opholileyo namanzi
amahle asemlanjeni aya kumthuthuzela.  

Umntu obabonayo angaqiniseka ukuba bayathandana, bevene nangokuba
lapha emlanjeni bobabini ngeli xesha.  

"Ndiqinisekile bayakukhumbula, kudala wabagqibela."  

Ukuba azimyeki, ziyamlandela, kuya kunyanzeleka ukuba abalekele
kwamalume wakhe, acele umntu amkhaphe amgoduse.  

"Ukho," uphendule ngelizwi elincinci uZuziwe, eziva enyanzelekile
ukuba amxelele inyani umhlobo lo wakhe.

ukuqala nje konyaka.

Wakha WALANDELA uyise ukuya kuzingela ngenye imini.

Kwiinkomo ezabuya noKhohlela kwaRharhabe singabalula ithokazi eliwasakazi
awayelithanda kakhulu, awathi akufika kwaGcaleka walithiya igama wathi
